notes.title: Red Spider Chronicle has been updated
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311711/fe287b696f460bacdbbbc93cd97a2c563d4aee20.jpg"][/img]We have added the content from the  Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered edition to the Red Spider Chronicle. The total page count is now 376 pages.[/p]

notes.title: New Game Release: Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered Is Out!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45311711/a50d8f1b46cccb596091cde02d70ba339786a852.jpg"][/img]To all our series fans,[/p][p]Thank you for your patience! We're excited to announce that Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered, the first title in the series, is officially released today, September 15th.[/p][p]We've completely overhauled the graphics, re-recorded some of the voices, and made detailed revisions to the text and the "CYCLOPEDIA" feature. We've put a lot of work into this to give you a deeper and more immersive experience.[/p][p]The game's full story is completely free to play. We invite you to dive into the world of the new Red Spider![/p][p]You can find the store page here:[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582550/Red_Spider/"]Red Spider:Vengeance Remastered[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Soundtrack has been released
notes.content:
We have released the original soundtrack of “Red Spider Anecdote: The Longest Nite”.
It includes 10 songs composed by Yasunori Shiono (Lufia Series) and Yukio Nakajima (Puzzle & Dragons), as well as the song “Freedom” from the game.
Reference book of Red Spider Series(PDF, written in Japanese) is also included.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3458370/_Soundtrack
